mpc.text: Skim milk is concentrated on an ultrafiltration membrane that keeps the casein and whey proteins and lets lactose, minerals and water through; for the higher grades water is added and filtered out again (diafiltration), then the retentate is evaporated and spray-dried.

milkPermeate.text: The membrane holds back the proteins and lets water, lactose, minerals and small nitrogen compounds through. That liquid is then concentrated and dried, often with a controlled crystallisation step first, into a powder of roughly 80 % lactose, 3 % protein and 8.5 % ash. It stands in for other dairy solids, sugar or corn syrup in bakery, pizza dough and confectionery, and is a lactose and mineral supply in animal feed.
